“Tohsaka…!”

I tear the wooden sword from its bag and pour magical energy into it.

There is no time to hesitate over Reinforcement.

“Tohsaka…!”

pages.en:
The scrap of cloth that descended before Kuzuki has taken on a human shape.

Slender female limbs emerge from a deep-violet robe.

—Spatial transfer.

Even in the modern age, pure teleportation belongs to the realm of Magic.

And there she stands: Caster, the black witch who embodies that Mystery as casually as breathing.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The robe that appeared in front of Kuzuki now takes form.
Female limbs appear from the bluish purple robe.
Teleportation.
A complete teleportation is considered to be a sorcery even in this modern world.
Caster has easily performed such a thing to appear in front of us.

masterKuzuki.

にも拘わらず、マスターである私がキャスターを放置しているのは、彼女に操られているからだと考えた訳だな」
pages.en:
“I see. An ordinary, decent man could not leave Caster to her own devices.

“Yet I, her Master, have done exactly that. Therefore, you concluded she must be controlling me.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I see. A normal human being would not be able to let her be.
So you thought I might be controlled since I am letting her do as she wishes.”

pages.ja:
「……ああ。もしアンタがキャスターの行為を知っていて放っておいているなら、アンタはただの殺人鬼だ。俺も容赦はしない。けどアンタが操られているんなら別だ。
俺たちはキャスターだけを倒す」
「いや。今の話は初耳だ」

pages.en:
“…Yes. If you know what Caster is doing and still allow it, then you're nothing but a murderer. I won't show you mercy. But if you're being controlled, that's different.

“We'll defeat Caster and no one else.”

“No. This is the first I have heard of it.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Yeah. But if you’re overlooking her deeds knowing what she’s doing, then you’re just a killer. We won’t hold back on you. But it’s a different story if you’re controlled.
We’ll just defeat Caster.”
“No. This is the first time I heard about this.”

I am not a magus. I am just a killer that has rotted away.”

Caster's incantation rises to meet her.

Five fathoms to close.

If Saber is a gust racing those ten meters in a single breath, then Caster, weaving her spell even faster, is thunder.

Thunder—and a raging storm besides.

In less than a second, five bolts of light fly from her fingers, thorns of death streaking out to skewer Saber—!

“Magic Resistance…! No. I know of no knight capable of nullifying my magecraft completely…!”
